citeAs: Mohamed A. Rashad (2024). Arabic-Nougat: Fine-Tuning Vision Transformers for Arabic OCR and Markdown Extraction. arXiv:2411.17835.
creator: Mohamed A. Rashad (Ain Shams University)
description: arabic-books is a large-scale dataset of 1.1 billion Arabic tokens extracted from over 8,500 Arabic books using the Arabic-Large-Nougat OCR model. It provides a valuable resource for downstream NLP tasks and further Arabic OCR research.
name: arabic-books
rai:dataBiases: The dataset is derived from Arabic books and may not generalize well to other domains of Arabic text, such as scientific, religious, or historical documents. The source material is limited to book-format content, which may introduce genre and style biases.
rai:dataCollection: The arabic-books dataset was created by extracting Arabic text from over 8,500 Arabic books using the Arabic-Large-Nougat OCR model (the state-of-the-art model introduced in the same paper), resulting in 1.1 billion Arabic tokens.
rai:dataCollectionRawData: Over 8,500 Arabic books (scanned or image-based documents) processed through the Arabic-Large-Nougat OCR model to extract structured Markdown text.
rai:dataLimitations: The dataset was extracted using an OCR model that may introduce hallucination and repetition errors. The arabic-large-nougat model used for extraction exhibits repetition issues in lengthy sequences. The dataset may not cover diverse genres such as scientific, religious, or historical Arabic texts. Complex layouts with dense tables, charts, or images may have been extracted with lower accuracy.
rai:dataSocialImpact: The dataset provides a large-scale Arabic text resource (1.1 billion tokens) that supports the digitization and accessibility of Arabic literature, promoting research in underrepresented languages and enabling downstream NLP applications for Arabic.
rai:dataUseCases: Downstream NLP tasks, Arabic OCR research, training data generation for Arabic language models, knowledge base creation, and information retrieval from Arabic literature.
rai:machineAnnotationTools: arabic-large-nougat — the state-of-the-art Arabic OCR model introduced in the same paper, used to extract text from Arabic book pages into Markdown format.
